sn12.47:1.2: Atha kho Jānussoṇi brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi || pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Jānussoṇi brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3
sn12.47:2.1: Kim nu kho bho Gotama sabbaṃ atthīti || ||
sn12.47:2.2: Sabbam atthīti kho brāhmaṇa ayam eko anto || || 4
sn12.47:3.1: Kiṃ pana bho Gotama sabbaṃ natthīti || ||
sn12.47:3.2: Sabbam natthīti kho brāhmaṇa ayaṃ dutiyo anto || ||
sn12.47:3.3: Ete te brāhmaṇa ubho ante anupagamma majjhena Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti || || 5
sn12.47:3.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || ||
sn12.47:3.9: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti || || 6
sn12.47:4.1: Evaṃ vutte so Jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
